quarterly_data.quarter: Baker Hughes press release: Baker Hughes Secures Major LNG Technology Order for Venture (07-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Venture Global: a major order, booked in the second quarter, to supply a liquefaction solution for Venture Global's CP2 LNG expansion in Louisiana under the existing master equipment supply agreement: six liquefaction blocks totaling 12 liquefaction modules, each block two single mixed-refrigerant modules with related compression trains using Baker Hughes centrifugal compressors, plus cold boxes, air coolers and integrated controls. Baker Hughes says it is a strategic supplier to Venture Global across more than 100 million tonnes per annum of existing and planned LNG capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: six liquefaction blocks, 12 liquefaction modules; booked in the second quarter
